info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Partner Authentication Management API
info.description: The Partner Authentication Management API facilitates secure authentication processes for partner integrations. This endpoint allows businesses to update authentication details for partner accounts, ensuring robust security measures. Typical consumers include development teams implementing partner solutions or managing access controls. Utilizing this API is crucial for maintaining compliance and enhancing user experience in partner interactions.

put.description: This endpoint is used to update authentication details for a partner. Ensure that all required fields are provided in the request body to successfully update the authentication information.

requestBody.description: Request body for authenticating partners. This payload must comply with the specified schema, which defines the required fields and their data types necessary for successful authentication.
